source_issue.title: Upgrade to Vale 3.18.0 to support MyST, moar new features  🎉

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on upgrading the Vale tool to version 3.18.0 to enable support for MyST (a Markdown flavor) and introduce new features. Vale helps in maintaining consistent documentation style.

## What needs to be done
1. Upgrade the project requirements to Vale 3.18.0.
2. Configure Vale to support MyST by following the [official documentation](https://docs.vale.sh/formats/myst).
3. Clean up the `accept.txt` file by removing spellings that Vale now ignores.
4. Implement a script for enforcing one sentence per line, which can be found [here](https://gist.github.com/jdkato/81508f54b34d7f0006aa90491257196b).

## Helpful background
Vale is a syntax-aware linter focused on improving style in documentation. MyST allows you to write documents in Markdown with special features, making it a powerful tool for technical writing.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with Vale and MyST by reviewing their official documentation.
2. Start with upgrading the Vale version in the project and configuring it as outlined.
3. Look into the spellings to be removed from `accept.txt`.
4. If you're interested, consider contributing to resolving any link check issues mentioned in comments, like adding URLs to `linkcheck_ignore`. 

Feel free to ask questions if any explanation is unclear!
